summary: Transform protected cell ranges after row and column insertions and deletions

traps.consequence: Off-by-one errors in every row/column coordinate transformation
traps.guard: Recognize 1-based edit indices explicitly; convert carefully if using 0-based internally

traps.quote: Do not enumerate individual worksheet cells or rows
traps.consequence: O(max_row × max_col) solution times out despite correct algorithm on large inputs
traps.guard: Use coordinate compression or interval tracking; never iterate over rows or materialize grid

traps.quote: Delete lines index through index+d-1. Cells in them disappear, later cells move by -d, and the final d lines become unprotected
traps.consequence: Rectangles overlapping deletion range not split; coordinates not adjusted; final rows incorrectly tracked
traps.guard: Split rectangles that span deleted range; shift later coordinates by -d; treat final d rows as unprotected

traps.quote: every maximal consecutive sequence of rows on which that exact maximal interval occurs becomes (first_row, c1, last_row, c2). Rectangles cannot be combined in any other way
traps.consequence: Rows merged across gaps or intervals merged incorrectly; output non-canonical
traps.guard: Merge only consecutive rows with identical maximal column interval; disallow any other combination

traps.quote: cells moved beyond the fixed worksheet boundary are discarded
traps.consequence: Rectangles extend beyond [1, max_row] × [1, max_col]; output contains invalid coordinates
traps.guard: Clip all rectangle coordinates to [1, max_row] and [1, max_col] after each edit; discard empty results

traps.quote: Sort the result lexicographically. Return [] for an empty union
traps.consequence: Output in arbitrary order or undefined behavior on empty set
traps.guard: Sort (r1,c1,r2,c2) tuples using default lexicographic ordering; handle empty result as []

input_shape: ranges: ≤30k inclusive (r1,c1,r2,c2) rects; edits: ≤30k of (axis, 1-based-index, delta); max_row, max_col ≤10^9
output_shape: (r1,c1,r2,c2) tuples in canonical row-run form, lexicographically sorted; [] if empty
invariants: Edits apply sequentially; each transforms all surviving rectangles
Protection moves with surviving cells; cells beyond boundaries disappear
Output cannot enumerate rows or cells; must use coordinate compression
